system.description:
Deal [(SR)D + (Attack Power)] physical damage. The [Hate] of this skill is equal to [Number of Targets + 1].

(Success): Reduce the [Hate] of number of allies equal to the targets and within 2 Sq by -1.

A special skill that allows you to overwhelm a large number of enemies by firing a large number of thrown weapons at once. The barrage that falls like a waterfall draws the enemy's attention to you.
